name: Dillinger
tagline: A cloud-enabled, mobile-ready, offline-storage, AngularJS powered HTML5 Markdown editor.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/dillinger:3.39.1@sha256:58dc39f6cddee732241c78f89805bca608299471f66ec90a8028e10b2cadd1b4
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
